note: Tavern placement, 1 racial + 1 neutral per zone, picked by Claude from brief_roc.md on 2026-10-05. Realm of Chaos has no F4 settlement dump yet, so picks go by area names.

suggestions.reason: Land of Stone and Steel, behind the Great Bastion, in a crowded patch (crowd 2).
The Imperial Road, Cathay's trade artery, far from the racial tavern.
The Red Wastes, the most crowded spot on the map (crowd 4).
Bloodfire Falls in the west, a waystation for every warband heading north. The duplicates 36 and 48 are left alone.
The Plain of Zharr, home of the Chaos Dwarfs. Set beside its spot, off the road.
The Howling Wastes, where Ogre and Hobgoblin traders pass.
Ostland, the Empire's front against the north, in its most crowded patch (crowd 3).
The Wasteland near Marienburg, the Old World's great free port. Set beside its spot, off the road.
Kislev city on the River Urskoy.
Erengrad, Kislev's sea port on the River Lynsk (crowd 2). Set beside its spot, off the road.
The heart of the Mountains of Mourn, Ogre country. Set beside its spot, off the road.
The Bone Road trade route. The zone has only 9 spots, all spread out. Set beside its spot, off the road.
The Ice Tooth Mountains in the middle of Norsca's west. Set beside its spot, off the road.
The Gianthome Mountains near the Goromadny, on the way to Kislev.
The Worlds Edge Mountains around Karaz-a-Karak. The zone has only 5 spots. Set beside its spot, off the road.
The High Pass, the road east out of the mountains.
